input.text:
After a loss, the loudest thought is often: make it back now.

Dani’s reset is simple: stop, write the rule, step away, then return only when calm has returned.

A loss does not need another trade to be resolved. Process first. Size second. Clarity before action.

Educational content only. Not financial advice.

#TheBetterTraders #TradingEducation #RiskManagement #TraderMindset
